nodes.text: The stand across the road at the fork is dying from the roots, and it will heat this village if somebody cuts it before frost. Bodil has a Charter licence to the thread. The old folk strung the thread. I want the wood inside it, where it is still standing, and I want it here as cord, and two of yew for the bows. The old folk will count it against you. I am telling you that because they will not.
Speak to Bodil at the cut. The licence is hers and the axe is yours. Look up before you swing. Look down too.
Then the village burns furniture in the new year.
